q1_issues.issue: The whenever/every-time machinery prescribes the response as a Skolem event per occurrence tied to its trigger with `During`, but the consequent state `(sk_potent $b)` is a function of the theme rather than of the trigger occurrence and carries no `During` link to `$g`.

q2_gaps: Recurring astronomical / lunar-phase time expression ("at the new moon"): the Time section's structured terms are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus deictic constants and the listed day-parts, and a lunar phase fits none, so the bare `new_moon` filler is an unguided extension of the day-part pattern (a compound filler in a Time slot also gets no decomposition guidance).
notes: "stays potent" correctly takes the continuation-copular shape (reified state + `Still` + flat atom, no matrix event, no `Result`), and `salt_bloom` correctly gets genus only with the noun modifier unexposed. The capitalized "Keeper" correctly stays a common-noun kind with no `Name` atom, and "that salt-bloom" is correctly bound to the premise variable.
